notes: This FIR is a repository-visible Tab widget progression slice beyond the current public reference runtime closure.
The Tab control value is the selected page id; page records remain source-owned .frog instance data.

Header sizing, per-page tab item layout, selected-row placement, selected-tab and selected-row join styling, constrained-width row wrapping, and overflow posture remain .frog-owned properties declared by the Default Tab realization surface.
This example keeps all five tab selectors on one row because the source-owned layout fits the published Default Tab header region.
The movable page label display is part of the Tab control surface, not a separate String indicator.
Interactive hosts may apply selected-page state patches without reloading the full document when the .wfrog host binding declares that capability.
Visible page content in this example is source-owned page record data, not runtime-hardcoded content.
The Default Tab SVG realization publishes tab_header_region, tab_item, tab_item_label, selection_face, page_label_display, page_region, page_container, and page_content parts.
Runtime implementation for this example continues in Graiphic/FROG-Runtime unless explicitly promoted later.
